who_may_join.text: To join, participants must be between 18-65 years old, have had a traumatic brain injury at least 1 year ago, be able to read and speak English fluently, and have difficulties with learning and memory skills.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will have cognitive questionnaires, blood tests, bone joint exams, and self-exams of joints at home. They will also complete questionnaires about their medications and supplements.

risks_or_burdens.text: There are no specific risks or burdens mentioned in the provided information.

time_commitment.text: The study involves about 5 minutes for completing questionnaires and a few phone calls every 2 weeks. There is no mention of a specific time commitment.

patient_facing_summary.text: This study looks at problems with attention or mental fatigue related to treatment. It involves cognitive questionnaires, blood tests, bone joint exams, and self-exams of joints at home. Participants will complete questionnaires about their medications and supplements. There are no specific risks or burdens mentioned.
